steps.title: IF you want a fairy ring …
steps.text: IF you want a fairy ring in your house keep in mind that you will be unlocking a lot of slayer monster by doing priest in peril so not recommended to this this b4 slayer

steps.title: Spectransfering yourself with slayer can be …
steps.text: Spectransfering yourself with slayer can be a really efficient way to get a lot of melee xp while still getting good slayer xp/h. ideally you want to have 2 xfer alts

steps.title: you need 91 magic for energy …
steps.text: you need 91 magic for energy transfer but 92 for heal other, so you want have 92 on atleast 1 alt

steps.title: having 82 con to boost for …
steps.text: having 82 con to boost for an ornate pool in your poh would be ideal but you can also get the Revitalisation pool and just bring food to heal yourself again on the alt (you only have to cast heal other a couple times per task)

steps.title: You want to set up your …
steps.text: You want to set up your house in a certain way so it loads in 2ticks. No upper or lower floors. like this: https://i.imgur.com/jrxJq0F.png and https://i.imgur.com/cYvdolY.png
